title: Valid Palindrome
statement: Given a string s, return true if its alphanumeric characters read the same forward and backward after ignoring case. Ignore all non-alphanumeric characters.
constraints: s contains ASCII letters, digits, punctuation, and spaces.

examples.input: s = "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"

examples.explanation: The normalized characters do not mirror each other.

arguments.s: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
